Terms of Service

1. Agreement to Terms

By inviting, installing, or using Nora within a Discord server, running commands via slash (/) or text prefix (n!, n?), or accessing the Nora Studio Dashboard, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, you must remove the bot from your server immediately.

2. Relationship with Discord

Nora is an independent application operating on the Discord platform. Our services rely entirely on the Discord API and Developer Applications Gateway. Users must comply with Discord's official Terms of Service, Developer Terms, and Community Guidelines in all actions associated with the bot.

3. Description of the Service & Feature Systems

Nora is an automated community moderation, engagement, and server telemetry ecosystem. Our platform provides automated feature systems including:

  • Multi-Mode Member Verification (v2.6): Server protection gates supporting 4 verification engines: 1-Click Instant Button, Anti-Bot Visual CAPTCHA, Emoji Reaction Verification, and Roblox Account Linking.
  • Security & Anti-Raid System (v2.1): Anti-raid gates, min account age filters, avatar requirements, and automated lockdown rules.
  • AFK & Availability Tracker (v2.6): Voluntary status broadcast system, auto-nickname prefixing ([AFK]), and automatic removal upon return.
  • Collaborative Community Games (v2.5): High-score Sequential Counting engine and One Word Story collaborative writing with automated milestone archives.
  • Roblox Verification & Role Sync (v2.4): Real-time Roblox identity verification, group rank sync bindings, and nickname enforcement.
  • Support Ticketing & Help Desk: Modal and button panel triggers, staff routing, automated transcripts, and category auto-archiving.
  • Starboard & Engagement: Community reaction voting reposting, custom trigger emojis, threshold configuration, custom webhook branding, and channel ignore filters.
  • Progression & Leveling Engine (v2.3): Experience gain algorithms, level role rewards, custom rank cards (custom colors, border accents, and background image uploads), and rank leaderboards.
  • Autoresponder & AI Bot Hooks: Keyword triggers, regex patterns, local Nora V10 engine processing, and external AI model integration options.

We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any feature, layout, or API endpoint at any time without prior notice to preserve operational stability and network security.

4. Moderation & Server Administration Responsibility

Nora provides automated assistance systems (such as AutoMod profanity filters, anti-spam gates, and warning thresholds). However, Nora does not replace human oversight. Server owners and designated administrators remain solely responsible for the actions executed by their staff and the configuration rules configured inside Nora.

5. Command and Permission Usage

Nora acts strictly upon the permissions granted by server administrators. We are not liable for misconfigurations or damage caused by granting excessive permissions (such as Administrator, Manage Roles, or Manage Channels) to the bot.

Nora integrates natively with Discord's Application Command Permission framework. All moderator and administrator commands are physically hidden at the client level from members lacking appropriate permissions. Both slash commands (/) and prefix commands (n!) enforce strict server-side permission checks before executing any action.

6. AI Interfaces (Local Engine & External Providers)

Certain features utilize local AI processing models or third-party AI APIs (including OpenAI and Google Gemini). AI-generated content is provided for contextual assistance, translation, and community engagement. We do not guarantee the absolute accuracy, completeness, or safety of automated AI responses.

7. Subscriptions, Payments & Premium Boosts

All financial transactions, premium subscriptions, and store purchases are processed securely through Discord's official Application Directory Store. Nora does not collect, store, or process credit card numbers, billing addresses, or banking details.

8. Limitation of Liability

Nora is provided "as is" and "as available". The developers (Vaztinix and the Nora team) disclaim all warranties and shall not be held liable for direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from bot downtime, third-party API disruptions, or server administration errors.

Privacy Policy

1. Privacy-First Philosophy

Nora was founded on a strict Zero-Access architecture. We believe that server data belongs to the community. Developers have no backend overrides to read server chat history, read configuration logs, or inspect private member details.

2. Data We Collect & Store

To provide baseline functionality, Nora stores minimal operational configuration data in our local database. This data includes:

  • Guild Configuration Records: Log channel IDs, welcome messages, verification modes and role IDs, ticket categories, AutoMod sensitivities, and Starboard settings.
  • Leveling & Engagement Statistics: User XP counts, server levels, custom rank card color hex values, and optional user-uploaded rank card background image URLs or base64 data.
  • AFK State (Temporary): User ID, voluntary AFK status text, timestamp, and previous nickname for automatic restoration. AFK records are erased immediately upon user return.
  • Roblox Verification Bindings: Linked Roblox user IDs and verified Discord account associations.
  • Moderation Case Logs: Active user warning counts and issued case reason strings.
  • Community Games: Current counting number and high scores; completed One Word Story transcripts.
  • Integrations: Top.gg integration secret tokens, vote log webhook URLs, and notification preferences.

We do not store message history permanently.

3. Message Processing

Message content is processed in real-time volatile memory strictly to enforce active moderation rules (AutoMod profanity/scam/mentions filters), process prefix commands (n!), evaluate counting games, or supply context to chosen AI engines. This processing occurs in memory and is instantly discarded; it is never written to disk or recorded in permanent storage.

4. AI Data Policies

We do not share your server's logs, member conversations, or leveling data with third parties for training machine learning models. Interactions with AI features are sent only to authorized processing endpoints (Local Nora Engine, OpenAI, or Google Gemini) strictly to generate real-time responses.

5. Web Dashboard & Session Security

The Nora Studio Dashboard connects directly via authorized Discord OAuth2 sessions. We do not permanently store your OAuth2 tokens; tokens are held in encrypted session storage and cleared upon logout. Dashboard operations enforce strict server administrator permission checks, ensuring only authorized administrators can alter guild settings.

6. User Sovereignty & The Data Kill Switch

We respect the right to be forgotten. Users can run the /mycard or n!mycard command inside Discord at any time to inspect their stored database record, and click the "Erase Data" button to immediately and permanently delete their leveling statistics, XP, Roblox connections, and warning records across all Nora nodes.

7. Server Data Isolation

Every server operates as an isolated container. Data, logs, settings, Starboard rules, and XP systems generated in one guild are strictly isolated and are never shared or made visible to other servers.

8. Data Erasure upon Bot Removal

If Nora is kicked or removed from a guild, all stored configuration records and log parameters associated with that server ID are scheduled for deletion to keep our databases clean and protect community privacy.
